info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Summary API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_ids to query on

params.name: formula
params.description: Query by formula including anonymized formula or by including wild cards. A comma delimited string list of anonymous formulas or regular formulas can also be provided.

params.name: chemsys
params.description: A comma delimited string list of chemical systems. Wildcards for unknown elements only supported for single chemsys queries

params.name: elements
params.description: Query by elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: exclude_elements
params.description: Query by excluded elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: possible_species
params.description: Comma delimited list of element symbols appended with oxidation states.                 (e.g. Cr2+,O2-)

params.name: crystal_system
params.description: Crystal system of the material. If a comma-separated string, will query by multiple crystal systems.

params.name: spacegroup_number
params.description: Space group number of the material. If a comma-separated string, will query by multiple space group numbers.

params.name: spacegroup_symbol
params.description: Space group symbol of the material. If a comma-separated string, will query by multiple space group numbers.

params.name: is_stable
params.description: Whether the material is stable.

params.name: theoretical
params.description: Whether the material is theoretical.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Magnetic ordering of the material.

params.name: is_gap_direct
params.description: Whether a band gap is direct or not.

params.name: is_metal
params.description: Whether the material is considered a metal.

params.description: Comma-delimited list of possible properties given by HasPropsEnum to search for.

params.description: Whether the material is marked as deprecated

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from SummaryDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `task_ids` `uncorrected_energy_per_atom` `energy_per_atom` `formation_energy_per_atom` `energy_above_hull` `is_stable` `equilibrium_reaction_energy_per_atom` `decomposes_to` `xas` `grain_boundaries` `band_gap` `cbm` `vbm` `efermi` `is_gap_direct` `is_metal` `es_source_calc_id` `bandstructure` `dos` `dos_energy_up` `dos_energy_down` `is_magnetic` `ordering` `total_magnetization` `total_magnetization_normalized_vol` `total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units` `num_magnetic_sites` `num_unique_magnetic_sites` `types_of_magnetic_species` `bulk_modulus` `shear_modulus` `universal_anisotropy` `homogeneous_poisson` `e_total` `e_ionic` `e_electronic` `n` `e_ij_max` `weighted_surface_energy_EV_PER_ANG2` `weighted_surface_energy` `weighted_work_function` `surface_anisotropy` `shape_factor` `has_reconstructed` `possible_species` `has_props` `theoretical` `database_IDs`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.

params.name: license
params.description: Query by license. Can be commercial or non-commercial, or both

params.name: _sort_fields
params.description: Comma delimited fields to sort with. Prefixing '-' to a field will force a sort in descending order.

params.description: Query by a comma-separated list of batch identifiers

params.name: batch_id_neq_any
params.description: Exclude a comma-separated list of batch identifiers
